limits: This is maintainer verification using a fresh public clone, not independent external adoption, a distinct-agent count or a fulfilled access-campaign target.
The 47 new workflow references and 33 changed source records were inspected as metadata; no upstream package, simulator, model weights, dataset, driver, robot or task was installed or executed.

All 80 added/changed full records and the 11 unchanged conflicted GaP references matched their SHA-bound public rows and exact fresh-clone metadata, for 91 full records total. This is finite selected-record coverage; complete inventory enumeration separately covered all 1224 thin rows.
The 12 NOASSERTION references retain verified=false: 11 GaP instruction license conflicts and one NoMaD mixed-notice source. No license clearance or preparation grant is inferred.

Existing robot types and named robot labels are discovery data. The two negative CLI queries confirm that humanoid is not converted into an exact robot model and that Unitree runtime/robot labels do not invent an environment combination.

All three source prepare --plan calls returned unsupported/source_reference_no_adapter without creating a target project or dedicated plan cache. These checks do not validate a runtime adapter or any robot execution.

Per-workflow requirements and separate model/checkpoint/dataset/service scopes were preserved in full public JSON and seven CLI inspections; dependency resolution and external asset access were not tested.
Optional llms-full.txt was readable as a 6595720-byte aggregate. Complete enumeration used bounded manifests/pages; the CLI used selected-record/search API reads and did not fetch the aggregate.
